summary: ServiceNow, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $4 billion debt offering via an underwritten takedown under an existing S-3 shelf. On May 15, 2026, it issued $4B aggregate principal in five tranches (2028-2056 maturities, 4.250%-6.300% coupons). Barclays, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, and Wells Fargo served as underwriters. The filing is a routine capital markets debt issuance, not a special situation. It creates a direct financial obligation but does not involve any M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic event.
